root_cause_summary: Test expects TypeError for device=123 but NPU runtime raises RuntimeError (invalid device ID). The pytest.raises(TypeError) catches the wrong exception type.

Test asserts param.to(npu_device) returns nn.Parameter, but PyTorch Parameter.to() returns a plain Tensor (with grad_fn) when moving to a different device. The isinstance check is an incorrect assumption about .to() semantics.

Test asserts _to_functional_tensor preserves requires_grad, but PyTorch functionalization intentionally does not propagate requires_grad to the functional wrapper. The assertion is incorrect for this internal API.
